subject: The 3-day test that changed 600 lives
preview_text: A simple challenge that helped 600+ people stop obsessing over their ex
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, at 3AM, I caught myself scrolling through old photos again. The same ones you probably have saved somewhere. The ones that make your chest tighten. I almost did it. But then I remembered something that changed everything: a 3-day challenge I tried when I was where you are now.

Here's what I learned: the first 72 hours are the hardest. Your brain is wired to replay the memories, the what-ifs, the pain. But if you can push through that window with a specific focus, something shifts. The obsessive thoughts start losing their grip. You begin to see a version of yourself that doesn't need them to feel whole.

That's why we built the 3-Day Challenge inside Fresh Start. It's not just random exercises. It's a curated path designed to interrupt the spiral. Day 1: a guided journal to dump every thought. Day 2: a no-contact streak that rewires your craving. Day 3: a coping strategy tailored to your breakup type. 600 users have tried it. Their average recovery time dropped by 40%. You're not starting from zero. You're just 72 hours away from feeling a difference.

Open the app now and tap '3-Day Challenge' on your home screen. It's waiting for you. P.S. Most people finish Day 2 and say the craving to check their ex's profile drops by half. See if that's true for you.
